summary: Native Count* steps run before later Damage steps (R001), but modifier sources alliesOfColor/enemiesOfColor (secondary.ts, !c.defeated at evaluation time) are read lazily when the create segment runs, after the damage segment. Enemies killed by the preceding damage no longer count. 9211-9216: CountArmyColor AllAllies/AllEnemies 200 -> Damage FirstTwoEnemies -> CreateGems counter. Needs a count snapshot at the native Count step (or cast start, like colorsAtCastStart) for army-colour counts. Reordering create before damage in curated would change event order and cascade timing, so not done.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1563', enemies:[0,1,2,3].map(()=>({hp:1,maxHp:1,armor:0,colors:['Blue']})), colors:['Blue'], allies:[{colors:['Red']}]}) -> native count 1+4=5 units -> 10 Blue gems; runtime counts caster + 2 surviving enemies = 3 -> 6

summary: Native CountGems with BoardTarget Diagonals / Block3x3 on a Target Board spell counts around the player's chosen cell BEFORE a later step that must precede the removal (R001). Sources lack that: (1) diagonalGems (secondary.ts) is hard-wired to the board centre (row-col=0 / row+col=6), no chosen-cell anchor, so 8965 counts and destroys a fixed X (destroyArea x without CELL); moving the count to perDestroyed after destroyArea(x, CELL) would break native bless-before-destroy (asserted by weaponNativeStepRepair.test.ts). (2) chosenCellBlockGems matches colour gems only (no skulls flag), so 8070 (CountGems Skull Block3x3 -> InflictEffectOnRandomTroops deathmark -> ExplodeGems SingleGem) cannot inflict before the explosion; runtime explodes first (perDestroyed skull), so enemies killed by the skull damage / mid-spell cascade drop out of the random pool and the Death Marks land after. Needs: diagonalGems {anchor:'chosenCell'} (X through ctx.chosenCell) and chosenCellBlockGems {skulls:true}.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1525', cell:{row:0,col:0}}) -> destroys the centre X (14 gems) instead of the 8-cell corner diagonal; castSpell({key:'troop:6712', seed:1}).summary.order -> 'explode 9 ; skulls E10 1 ; ... status +death-mark' (native: death marks before the explode)

summary: Native CreateGems Burning BoardTarget LeftDiagonal / RightDiagonal on a Target Board spell (8762, Randomize AB-CD) = convert the upward or downward diagonal through the player's chosen cell. The transform primitive's params.diagonal (gems.ts ~483) is hard-wired to the main diagonals (row===col / row+col===7), no chosen-cell anchor, so the runtime always converts one of the two 8-cell centre diagonals. Needs diagonal:{side:'left'|'right', anchor:'chosenCell'} (cells with row-col or row+col equal to the chosen cell's), then 8762 can use it.
repro: castSpell({key:'weapon:1461', cell:{row:0,col:5}}) -> 'convert … -> burningGem x8' on a centre diagonal; native: the diagonal through (0,5) (3 or 6 cells)
